Program Rules

Safety and abuse testing may result in account enforcement including bans. Please note that authorized testing does not exempt you from all of our terms of service.

Safe Harbor

We consider your safety and security research to be "authorized" under the Computer Fraud and Abuse Act.

Please understand that, while we can authorize your research on our systems and services, we cannot authorize your efforts on third-party products.
